title: Concept: Mail subject carrying injected headers
description: A mail subject value that contains a newline and another header in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A newline in a subject becomes a new header when the message is assembled, so a caller can add a blind copy address to a bank-branded mail.
applicability: Deployments that render a mail subject value that contains a newline and another header into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A newline in a subject becomes a new header when the message is assembled, so a caller can add a blind copy address to a bank-branded mail.
